description: Funds are discontinued; this is only for someone still holding shares in a pooled Fund. The unsigned transaction that asks the Fund to buy back shares (a number of shares, or "all"), or takes back a request still in the open batch (cancel: true, with epoch). Priced at a later settlement; claim the USDC with fund_claim. For the holder's own wallet to sign; AINDEX sends nothing.

cancel.description: Take back a deposit or redemption request instead

epoch.description: The batch of the request to take back; every one that can be, when left out

name: fund_redeem
title: Leave a discontinued pooled Fund
